scope: Amendment-level significance of an evidenced legal-text change; not a scenario-specific compliance outcome.

levels.label: High
levels.definition: The evidenced amendment changes a substantive right, obligation, prohibition, legal scope or eligibility, liability, penalty, controlling exception, or major compliance requirement.
include_when: A duty is created, removed, or substantively changed
Conduct or persons covered by the law materially changes
A prohibition, liability, penalty, or controlling exception materially changes
The amendment substantively changes a major compliance requirement
exclude_when: Only wording length or edit distance changes
Only one scenario outcome changes without amendment-level significance evidence
The source evidence does not establish what changed
levels.boundary_rule: A change to a deadline or amount is not automatically High; use High only where evidence supports a fundamental substantive effect beyond a procedural parameter.

levels.label: Medium
levels.definition: The evidenced amendment changes an operative compliance procedure, filing/reporting method, deadline, threshold, evidentiary requirement, or implementation condition while retaining the basic allocation of rights and duties.
include_when: A required procedure or filing process changes
An operative deadline or threshold changes with practical compliance significance
Conditions or evidence required to satisfy an existing duty change
exclude_when: The change fundamentally reallocates rights/duties or changes material liability (High)
Only presentation changes with no operative effect (None)
No evidence establishes the parameter or process change
levels.boundary_rule: A numeric change must be interpreted in context; a 10-to-15-day change is ordinarily Medium only when the cited text confirms the period is operative.

levels.label: Low
levels.definition: The evidenced amendment makes a narrow clarification, terminology update, cross-reference repair, or limited administrative refinement with no demonstrated material change to the core obligation or compliance outcome.
include_when: A narrow clarification preserves the operative rule
A cross-reference is repaired while preserving the target
Administrative wording is refined without substantive effect
exclude_when: A substantive legal effect or practical procedure changes (High/Medium)
The evidence is too incomplete to distinguish a limited clarification from a material change
levels.boundary_rule: Do not infer Low merely from short text or small edit distance.

levels.label: None
levels.definition: The complete, sufficiently grounded comparison supports only a non-operative editorial/presentation change and supports no legal or compliance effect.
include_when: Punctuation, spelling, layout, or mechanical renumbering changes while legal meaning and references are demonstrably preserved
exclude_when: Any supported change to legal scope, obligation, procedure, threshold, deadline, liability, or effect
Only a normalized-text match is available without contextual source support
levels.boundary_rule: A model must not infer None from missing evidence; use INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE when legal-effect absence cannot be supported.

decision_protocol: Compare amendment operation with the complete supplied before/after excerpts and source anchors.
Separate amendment materiality from temporal applicability and scenario-specific compliance consequence.
Cite exact evidence spans from supplied source records for each material claim.
If the version, operation, source, context, or legal effect is insufficiently evidenced, abstain rather than guessing.
Even a schema-valid, source-grounded machine assessment has workflow status REVIEW_REQUIRED and is not legal gold.
prohibited_inferences: The machine consensus label is adjudicated ground truth
Majority voting or LLM agreement replaces legal validation
Materiality alone determines a scenario's compliance consequence
